images.prompt: A perfectly seamless tileable ocean water texture seen from directly above. Deep blue-teal Caribbean ocean surface with subtle wave patterns, light caustic ripples, and gentle foam traces. No land, no rocks, no shore, no horizon, no objects — pure open ocean surface only. The texture must tile seamlessly in all directions with no visible seam when repeated. Uniform lighting, no strong directional shadows. Color palette: deep navy blue (#063c64) to teal (#0a5279) with subtle lighter (#7fc6d3) ripple highlights.
